transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm here because of some things happening at work. I keep... I keep hearing these voices. They come from the call-light speaker, and... the hallway vents. Just telling me which patient records have been changed. 

It sounds clear, like... like somebody is standing right next to me. But even when the unit is dead quiet, nobody else seems to hear it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do the voices ever tell you to do something?
No... they don't really do that. Just... just what I said before. About the records. That's all.
Are the voices happening all the time or do they come and go?
I'm not really sure. I guess... they come and go. I haven't really kept track of exactly when it happens.
Do the voices only happen when you are at work or do you hear them at other times and places as well?
I... I don't know. I think... maybe just at work. I haven't really noticed them anywhere else. Just... when I'm there.
Do the voices sound like your own voice or like someone else's voice?

No... not mine. It sounds like... someone else. It's just... clear, like somebody standing right next to me. Coming from the call-light speaker, mostly... or the hallway vents. Even when the unit is quiet and... nobody else hears it.
Do the voices ever criticize you or say anything negative?
I don't know. I guess... not really. Just... saying things. I haven't really paid that much attention to it.
Do you see things that other people don't see?
No. I don't think so. I haven't... I don't see anything.
Do the voices bother you or cause you any distress?
I don't know. Not really, I guess. They're just... there. I try not to think about it too much.
Can you make the voices stop by doing something or is it completely out of your control?

I don't... I can't really control it. They just happen. Like... I'll just be at work, and I hear them coming from the call-light speaker. Or the vents in the hallway. Just... telling me which patient records got changed. It's... it's as clear as someone standing right next to me, even when the unit's completely quiet. Nobody else seems to hear it, but... I can't make it stop.
Do you feel like the voices are a part of you or something separate from you?
I don't really know. Um... I guess they seem separate. Like I said, it sounds like it's coming from the speakers. I haven't really... thought about it like that.
Are the voices more likely to happen when you're under a lot of stress or pressure at work?

I mean... maybe? I never heard the call-lights talking before recently. Or... or saw those hidden messages in the charts. 

It wasn't until... um... until I got so wound up about the new rollout at work. I was just working nonstop, not really sleeping much. I just felt this... certainty, like I had to fix everything at the facility myself. So... yeah, I guess they only started after all that.
Do you believe that there is a hidden meaning or message in the patient records that the voices are telling you about?

Well... yes. I mean... I know the wound-care charts are showing a pattern. Management doesn't really want anyone to see it. 

My supervisor... she just brushed it off. Said it was just late entries, or... coding mistakes. But I know what I saw. And... I can tell they're watching what I write in the system now. Just because I'm the one who caught it. So... yeah.
Do you think others would agree that there's a hidden pattern in the wound-care charts if they looked at them?

I don't know if they'd agree. I mean... I already told you what my supervisor said. She just brushed it off. But... I know what I saw. It's there. Even if they don't want to admit it... I know they're watching me now because I figured it out. I just... I don't really want to talk about it anymore.
Do you think someone is actually watching you or trying to hide something from you outside of what the voices are telling you about the patient records?

I... I already said that. The pattern is there in the charts. Management is hiding it. And... yes, I know they're monitoring what I put in the system now. My supervisor tried to pass it off as coding mistakes, but... I know they're watching me because I'm the one who caught it. That's... that's all I want to say about it.
Do you think the pattern you see in the wound-care charts could be explained by something other than a hidden message or management hiding something?

No. I... my supervisor already tried to tell me it was just late entries or coding errors. But no. It's not. I know what I saw in those charts. And I know why they're watching my log-ins now. I really... I don't want to keep going over this.
Do you think it's possible that you're misinterpreting the information in the wound-care charts?

No. I'm not misinterpreting anything. I... I already told you. I know the pattern is there. Management just doesn't want anyone to see it. My supervisor said it was coding mistakes, but... I know better. They're watching everything I write now because I caught it. I don't... I really don't want to talk about this anymore.
Do you think management's supposed monitoring of your activities is related to anything beyond the wound-care charts?

No. Just... just those charts. I keep telling you. I know they're showing a pattern management doesn't want anyone to see. My supervisor can say it's just late entries or... or coding mistakes all she wants, but I can tell they're watching what I write because I'm the one who caught it. That's it. I don't... I have nothing else to say about it.
Do you think management is out to get you personally, beyond just monitoring your activities related to the wound-care charts?

No, I... I didn't say they were out to get me. I just... I told you, I know what the wound-care charts are showing. I know there's a pattern management doesn't want anyone to see. My supervisor keeps making excuses, saying it's late entries or coding mistakes, but... I know they're watching what I write. Because I caught it. That's all it is. I'm... I'm done talking about the charts now.
Do you think the pattern you see in the wound-care charts is real, even if nobody else believes you?

I... I thought I just said I was done talking about this. Yes, it's real. I know what the charts are showing. Management is hiding it. My supervisor can keep blaming coding mistakes and late entries all she wants, but... I know they're watching my notes now because I caught the pattern. I know what I saw. Please... just ask about something else.
Do you think there's anything else going on that you're not supposed to know about, outside of what's happening with the patient records?

I... no. I don't know about anything else. Just the charts. I already told you about the wound-care charts. I know what the pattern is, and I know management is trying to cover it up. My supervisor keeps making those same excuses about coding and late entries, but... I know they're watching me. They're watching my notes because I saw it. I don't... I don't know about anything else. I really don't want to talk about this anymore.
